mathematical_status: Actual bounded Poisson rejection full-batch estimator count C, including the successful batch. For 0<delta<1 and L=log(2/delta), proves P(C>2B(e-1)ceil(exp(2B)L)+L)<=delta and P(C>K(B)L)<=delta, where K(B)=2B(e-1)(exp(2B)+1/log(2))+1. Acceptance lower bound is obtained from the existing production PoissonRejection theorem, not assumed. Actual product count law, pathwise truncation, iid prefix Chernoff and failure bounds are proved.
